# Daily Briefing — Friday 28 August

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training recorded and 6,762 steps, which is a decent baseline movement day. Your body burned 2,400 kcal, essentially matching your 2,300 target, so energy balance looks solid. The main flag is sleep: 5.2 hours simply isn't enough to support your goals.

Your HRV sits at 95ms, below your 99–118ms baseline, and that short sleep is almost certainly the culprit. The good news? Resting HR at 49bpm and stress at 28/100 suggest your body isn't in crisis — just slightly under-recovered. Train today, but keep intensity honest rather than pushing hard efforts.

That 5.2-hour night is your biggest priority today. Poor sleep blunts protein synthesis, meaning your 175g protein target works less effectively. Aim for bed 30 minutes earlier tonight — small shift, real gains. You've got 104 days to build something great. Protect your recovery.
